programme.desc: For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Darkness At The End Of The Tunnel
programme.desc: After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part of their ultimate plan to capture all Bit Beasts in the world. A massive battle ensues but the odds are against our heroes. Finally, Kai shows up with his newly modified Dranzer and almost single-handedly wins the battle. The Dark Bladers fade away after their humiliating loss and just when you'd think it's over, a mysterious kid named Oliver shows up'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Unwilling to let his initial defeat to Enrique faze him, Tyson gets busy reworking his Beyblade. With Enrique having doubts about his own technique, and Oliver visiting him in Rome from France, the stage is set for a rematch. This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. The reason - Tyson hopes to avenge an earlier loss to Robert that happened onboard the ship coming to Europe. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' So, Tyson decides to find Robert on his own and ends up getting lost in the medieval castles many eerie secret passages. Finally everyone converges in the room where Robert is playing chess against Johnny and it's here where Tyson throws down the gauntlet and challenges Robert to a rematch. Robert refuses and goes into a whole history lesson about how 'once you've defeated your enemy, the battle is over.' Meanwhile, the arrogant little Johnny decides to pick a battle with the most-worthy opponent in the room and chooses Kai. As the fight begins, it appears to be even, but then Johnny calls out his Bit Beast Salamulyon and totally destroys him. In the end, the Bladebreakers resolve that they have their work cut out for them to become the world champion Beybladers!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers have made themselves at home at Robert's mansion, refusing to leave unless the Europeans agree to a final Beybattle. To teach his guests a lesson, Robert agrees to a match at his new stadium. But there's one condition: If the Bladebreakers lose, they have to forfeit their berth at the world Championship. Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Match two gets underway at the Olympia Coliseum, and with a little unsolicited help by his teammates, Kai walks away with a win. The match is tied and the Majestics grudgingly admit to themselves that the only way they'll win the contest is to fight as a team, as the Bladebreakers do. Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Hot Battle In A Cold Town
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should test his blading skills against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into deadly Beybladers. Kai's lost memories come flooding back as he realizes he was raised in the abbey. But has he discovered the truth too late?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a child, and the lure of its dark, corrupting power leads Kai to a shocking decision.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demolition Boys who quickly go up 2-0 in the best of five events. In the next match, Michael has to square off against a mystery member of the Demolition Boys and it turns out to be none other than Kai who has defected from the Bladebreakers. In the final battle, Kai takes on all the All Starz at once' and wins!! After his victory, he commands the All Starz Bit Beasts to enter his blade and he announces to the world that he now possesses the most powerful Beyblade in the world!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tells him to leave. Will the Bladebreakers survive the loss of their most powerful member?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his friends. Unfortunately he loses his Bit-Beast, Draciel, in the process'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally confuses Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The World Championship Finals are finally here and Kai insists on Beybattling first, hoping his knowledge of the Demolition Boys will give him an advantage over Spencer. But in the first set, Seaborg, Spencer's whale Bit Beast, uses the water in the Black Sea Bowl to create a tsunami, which overwhelms Dranzer. Kai is desperate for victory and Voltaire makes him a tempting offer: the power of Black Dranzer in exchange for betraying his friends and stealing their Bit Beasts. Kai stays true to his heart and resists his grandfather.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After Kai's first round loss to the Demolition Boys in the World Beyblade Finals, it's Ray's turn to take on Bryan in a best-of-three match. Ray learns the hard way that Bryan is a nasty competitor who'll do anything to win - including putting Ray himself through the ringer. When it's discovered that Bryan's attack includes the ability to manipulate air itself into a weapon, Ray faces a troubling realization. To negate Bryan's fury, he must put his own well being at risk. But Ray's Bit-Beast Driger has other ideas, and it offers up selfless act of its own.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After a devastating match puts Ray in the hospital, Tyson trains his heart out to prepare for his battle against Tala, leader of the Demolition Boys. What Tyson doesn't know is that Tala has become one of Boris' weird experiments, uploaded with dangerous Biovolt technology. Meanwhile, Max's parents work together to come up with an improved Beyblade that can combat the existing threat of the Demolition Boys' prowess. Can it even come close to competing against'Cyber-Tala?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It is the finals of the World Beyblading Championships in Moscow with Tala from the Demolition Boys and Tyson tied at one game a piece in the best of three finals. With the victory, the tide has turned in favor of Tala who warps the two warriors into a giant iceberg where there is no contact with the outside world. The second battle begins, and it takes little time for Tala to combine his multiple Bit Beasts into one and take the lead in the best of three finals. Meanwhile, the evil Voltaire, head of the Biovolt Corporation looks on and begins celebrating the victory, which translates into his domination of the corporate world.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is back home from just winning the World Beyblade Championships and he thinks he's one hot dude!! But after disrupting his homeroom at school, he's punished with a detention which makes him late for a local tournament. When he finally get there, he's confronted with a mystery kid, Mister X, who battles his way to the finals to face off against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kenny learns that the cloaked Blader named Ozuma, who defeated Tyson in an informal, Supermarket-sponsored Beybattle, was using an invisible Bit-Beast. Tyson demands a rematch against the strange opponent ' and loses for a second time when Dragoon mysteriously fails to appear on command. Effects from the battle damaged Dizzi, whom Kenny endeavors to repair. Meanwhile, a group of shady Men in Black have been busy monitoring Tyson and Ozuma the entire time. At school, tensions between Tyson and Hilary continue to rise.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson still can't get over losing his town's Beyblade Tournament to the mysterious Mister X. Kenny and Dizzi try to come up with some answers but discover a greater mystery. On the same day as Tyson's loss, Max and Ray were also visited by similar shadowy figures that defeated them as well. While Tyson does his best to avoid his school chores, Kenny makes a startling discovery about Mister X's Beyblade. Unfortunately Tyson, unaware of this new information, unexpectedly runs into Mister X at the park and challenges him to a rematch!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson heads to the park to meet Kenny, who has a plan to get Dragoon back 'on line'. But when Kenny and Hilary are kidnapped, Tyson is forced to jump through a series of hoops set out by their captors, which test his speed and determination. After successfully completing their orders, Tyson finds himself on a ship equipped with a fancy computer system ' and his friends, locked in a glass-walled cage. But what do the kidnappers want ' and how far will they go to get it?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny are safe on dry land once again but are totally baffled trying to figure out why Kenny and Hilary were kidnapped by two mystery men. The best that they can deduce is that two factions are out to steal the Bit Beasts of all the members of the BladeBreakers. This leads them to wonder about Kai who supposedly has retired.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Inside Gideon's training center two of his henchmen discover a talented Blader named Snakey and offer to equip his Blade with the Magtram. The Magtram is a device that creates a magnetic field around the user's Beyblade and gives an unfair advantage to anyone using it. Kenny and Hilary are on the look out for their mysterious captors when Tyson shows up with a new scheme to find Ozuma. Out of nowhere, Snakey shows up and challenges Tyson to a match.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny try to determine what the mystery material was inside Snakey's Beyblade that made it so magnetic. Kai is tight-lipped after rejoining his friends following his draw against Dunga. Kai crashes at Tyson's place, but departs quickly after old grievances resurface, and Hilary suspects him of being a spy. Tyson and Kenny e-mail Max's Mom, asking for help with their analysis of the mystery metal, while Hilary suggests visiting another person who could help them - Mr. Dickenson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: At long last, Max and Ray rejoin their friends and the Bladebreakers are back together again! Just in time to meet their opponents, Team Psykick. With one week to train, the guys have victory on their brains ' especially after Max and Kenny reveal the new technology developed by Max's mom. The MG Core produces a magnetic field similar to the one in the Magtram technology, giving the user optimal control over their Beyblade and increasing the Beyblades power ten fold. However, it's not an easy thing to control, and the guys have a rough start.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers were on route to take on Team Psykick in a tournament when the Driver filled the bus with sleeping gas. While unconscious, they were quickly whisked away to a deserted island where Doctor B, Gideon's minion, was assigned to steal the Bit Beasts from all four team members with a Bit-Beast Capturing System.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are trapped on a mysterious island and not sure how to get off, so they decide to split up. Hilary, Kai and Kenny head for the lighthouse where they hope to find a way to communicate with the outside world and call for help, while Tyson, Ray and Max accidentally find themselves at the site of their next battle. Kai's gang faces difficult obstacles when their mysterious captor tries to dissuade them from reaching the lighthouse, and they barely escape in one piece.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: The Evil Island Of Dr. B
programme.desc: Our heroes are still trapped on a deserted island and are puppets of the evil Doctor B who's intent is to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts. But he does make a deal with the kids that if each member of the Bladebreakers can defeat a member of Team Psykick, he'll release them. Only two haven't fought yet- Tyson and Kai. The first battle is between Kai and Figel that Kai wins handily. After the battle, Kenny, Kai and Hilary resume their quest to the lighthouse to get a clear satellite signal to get help from the outside. Finally they make contact, but not before they return to find Tyson in battle against another member of Team Psykick, Daryl.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson recuperates in the hospital after being rescued from the island where he fought Team Psykick. Away from school, Tyson discovers he really likes hospital life until Hilary shows up with all his homework assignments. Meanwhile Gideon, frustrated with his attempts to capture the BladeBreakers Bit Beasts, hatches a sinister new plan. He demands that Doctor B and his team create powerful Cyber Bit Beasts using the data they have gathered on the Blade Breakers. The only problem is their data is incomplete.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Joseph of the Saint Shields infiltrates the Psykick's laboratory and discovers their latest, sinister plan. Gideon and Doctor B are using the data they collected on the Blade Breakers to create Cyber Bit-Beasts based on the ones our heroes use. But the Doctor's first test ends in disaster; the Cyber Bit Beasts aren't quite ready yet. As for the BladeBreakers, they learn that the group who've been using invisible Bit Beasts against them - the Saint Shields - are all in the vicinity.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes have been confronted by Joseph and Mariam and just as Tyson runs up, Ozuma, the Saint Shields leader, challenges Tyson to a battle. As it rages on, Tyson is forced to call out his Victory Tornado Attack in order to win. After the fight, Ozuma flippantly tells Tyson he needs to 'improve his Bit Beast Technique' which stumps Tyson to no end, especially after winning!! Meanwhile, Gideon oversees Doctor B who unveils the first ever Cyber Bit Beast which is the most powerful Beast in the world. This cloned power from the Sacred Bit Beasts has been compressed into one blade. But first it has to be tested and Gerry, one of the best Blader's Team Psykick has to offer, is chosen. His mission is to enter a local tournament and draw out the Cyber Beast in battle to see how it handles. Oddly enough, the BladeBreakers show up at the same tournament just as Gerry calls out his Bit Beast. This is when things go horribly wrong as the Beast goes totally out of control and self destructs leaving the BladeBreakers to wonder what Team Psykick are up to!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Gerry of Team Psychic's lack of control led to an explosive conclusion when his Cyber Bit Beast blew up. The Blade Breakers were at a loss as to how that could happen so Kenny consulted his trusty laptop Dizzi and made a startling revelation. Someone had managed to make copies of the Blade Breakers Bit Beasts! This discovery leads the gang to believe that new powerful Bit Beasts are being developed and they decide to get themselves in shape for battle. Ozuma and his gang, the Saint Shields, are still eager to test the power of the Blade Breakers' Bit Beasts as well, so they head to the beach where Tyson and the others are training. Meanwhile Doctor B is busy experimenting with various versions of a Cyber Bit Beast with mixed results.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kai's classmate Wyatt returns and begs Kai to help him train to become a first-class Beyblader. Remembering the time back at school that Wyatt betrayed Kai by stealing Dranzer and using it in battle, Kai turns him down. Hurt, Wyatt vows to return and battle Kai one day. That day may be sooner than anyone thinks' for the mysterious Dr. B and his team of scientists have finally re-developed the Cyber Bit Beast and are looking for a Blader with the skill to handle it. Dr. B approaches Wyatt with an offer to join Team Psykick, and Wyatt jumps at the chance.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After Dunga and Wyatt battle, Wyatt realizes he doesn't possess the skill necessary to control his Cyber Bit Beast. This frustrates Gideon, so he commands Doctor B to seek out a suitable candidate for the job. Meanwhile, Tyson is back home practicing his blading and quickly tires of it. The rest of the BladeBreakers, including Hilary, keep harping on him to continue until he gets it right. But Tyson has had enough and quits! It seems the BladeBreakers are finished! Then, Hilary comes up with an idea! She tells the guys to take a day off and invites them to an afternoon barbecue with Grandpa playing the part of the Chef. At first Tyson wants nothing to do with it, but finally he relents and joins in. After lunch, the kids relax by the river while Grandpa fishes. Suddenly he hooks a big one and gets dragged in the water! The kids run to the rescue, however, a group of four new teenagers appear out of nowhere and rescue Gramps. After a brief conversation, our heroes realize these new kids are also Bladers, so Tyson challenges their leader, Kane, to a battle. After a fierce fight, it ends in a tie and the new kids leave. Tyson thinks he made a new friend, but as it turns out, Kane is the leader of the Psykick's and is in cahoots with the evil Gideon!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kane, Goki, Jim, and Salima arrive at Doctor B's lab to begin battle tests for Gideon. Jim goes first after being given his new Beyblade, Cyber Draciel. He battles against a lopsided number of automated Beyblades, including one behemoth the size of a football. But with Cyber Draciel in tow, victory is decisive. It's obvious however, that the Cyber Bit-Beast's power is having a corrupting influence on Jim. At Mr. Dickenson's office, the BladeBreakers are blackmailed into a future battle against the Psykick's when Doctor B threatens an all-out assault on the city by the Cyber Bit-Beasts. When Tyson hears that his new friend Kane has joined the Psykick's, he refuses to believe it without concrete proof.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After seeing the power of the Cyber Bit Beasts in Team Psykick's Beyblades, Tyson vows to do whatever it takes to beat them. Even if that means breaking the rules and modifying his own Beyblade. Ray protests and demands that the BladeBreakers play fair even if the odds are against them. In a quiet moment down by the river he runs into Salima of Team Psykick and discovers she feels the same way as he does. Salima tries to convince Ray to get the BladeBreakers to forfeit their upcoming match and even offers to reveal the secrets of the Cyber Bit Beasts.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is so determined to beat the Psykick's in an upcoming battle that he's ordered Kenny to modify his Dragoon beyond legal specifications. But because his blade now has too much offensive power, Tyson is unable to control it and he becomes totally frustrated with himself and his blade. The more he tries controlling it, the worse he becomes. His friends try to tell him 'cheating' isn't the way to win, yet Tyson ignores them and being pigheaded as he is, he goes off to sulk about his dilemma.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.sub-title: Amazonas - Providencia & the Wisdom of the Bora
programme.desc: As the floating hospital leaves La Chorrera, Jeff arrives in the village of Providencia—home to the Bora people, whose culture is deeply tied to the sacred triad of coca, tobacco, and cassava. Unexpectedly, Jeff stumbles upon a rare and powerful event: a regional summit where Indigenous chiefs from across the Amazon have gathered to discuss peace, territory, and cultural preservation—an event many call the “G7 of the Amazon.” Following tradition, Jeff must await an invitation to meet the local chief. While respectfully waiting, he spends a day with a local fisherman, navigating the winding rivers and gaining insight into traditional fishing practices passed down through generations.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.sub-title: American Travelers: New Zealand Australia Adventures
programme.desc: Dave and Kari take a cruise to New Zealand, Tasmania, and Australia.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritians have a passion for tea. Their esteem and adoration almost match that of the British. Vanilla tea in particular, is a staple in Mauritian house-holds. Brent begins his journey into the history of this grand love affair at Bois Cheri Tea Factory, home to some of the oldest tea fields on the island. After learning how tea goes from a leafy bush to a brew-able bag he gets to experience the various flavours at a tea tasting with a view. Brent then meets up with a Mauritian local, Aurelie, at Flaq market to buy ingredients for a tea dish she is going to teach him. It's a beautiful day and, regardless of his fear of heights, Brent decides to fit in some parasailing before the cook. He then heads to Cap Malheureux where he and Aurelie cook her mother's tea chicken dish.

programme.title: Toque 12

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: A beautiful tropical island, two world class restaurants and two great Chefs ,Chef Phil and his old friend Chef Richard. programme.title: Toque 12

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This place rocks and it does in a very Argentinian way.The best meat cooked to perfection is what we see and learn how to achieve. At Pampas meat is what they are all about and Chef Phil discovers thats why the place is packed out every night.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This is an episode dedicated to decadence. Sit back, relax and salivate. Chef Phil and Chef Gaeton take us through the intracacies of making a modern boulliabase from scratch. It is an art. As well we will learn what herbs and spices it takes to lift any gin to levels heavenly.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: We are nearly 60 stories up looking over super KL modern city with the twin towers in our face. This is Italian high end cuisine cooked by owner/chef Modesto Marini himself. We see him with Chef Phil in the working kitchen cooking some Marini signatures and later at the bar delving into some mysterious cocktails.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This Venue is quite simply downright impressive and the big question to come was will the kitchen produce a match for where it will be presented. We see Chef Phil work his way through the decadent degustation then migrate to the kitchen to learn about the preparation.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Another extraordinarily extravagant venue in the centre of the KL Culinary universe. Marble 8 is like a club for the rich and famous in New York or Hollywood and from from what Chef eats, drinks and cooks it could as well be.This is a lavish treat from the walk through the steak aging vault to the flaming crepe suzette prepared at the table.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Yet another culinary gem in the suburbs of KL.This is real Italian with an intense Abruzzian Italian at the helm. Chef Stefano is young and like most great Italian chefs Stefano’s inspiration came from his mothers cooking.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Pedro tiene montado en una de las habitaciones de su apartamento un sistema de espionaje a los vecinos del condominio. Con cámaras instaladas dentro de las viviendas, va manejando y observando las conversaciones y los detalles de la vida de cada uno de los habitantes del complejo. Es así que se entera de todos los pormenores, y entre ellos descubre a Cristóbal en una conversación consigo mismo en donde deja a la luz su sospecha de infidelidad entre Ana y su primo Guillermo.

programme.title: Episodio 109
programme.desc: Yubiri está super feliz en su casa repartiendo regalos a su familia y todos están que brincan de la felicidad. Lolita le dice a Wilker que la gorrita se la regaló Yubiri. Llega Solymar y comienzan a hablar sobre lo de la presentación. ROKUro y Segundo conversan de los regalos hechos por Yubiri para estrenarlos con sus respectivas conquistas. En casa de Briggite están hablando ella Carolina y Dionisia de quienes se están por casar. Llega Junior para informarles que al otro día se casa.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel debe alejarse de la ciudad para llegar a un pueblo llamado Caja Seca por razones de trabajo. Lo que nunca se imagina es que Magdalena se encuentre en ese pueblo también por asuntos laborales, y el destino hace que se junten. Gloria decide contarle a Gabriel que ella ya está al tanto de la enfermedad que tiene él en los riñones. Su intención es ayudarlo en lo que necesite y que pueda confiar en ella. Sin embargo, él siente que la gente le puede llegar a tener lástima y, por eso, quiere callar. Angie y Agustín están desesperados por comunicarse con sus respectivas parejas. Ellos llaman a Gabriel y a Magdalena pero no obtienen ninguna respuesta.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo deja a Katiuska y se va de su casa. Celia regresa a su hogar en estado grave, mientras Manuela busca a su hermana Cecilia para que se reconcilien. Vincenzo y Tirsa informan sobre el testamento de la Nona. Katiuska manipula a Glorita para que odie a Ricardo y enfrenta una orden de ADN de Misael. Marcelo se indigna por la confesión de María del Pilar sobre Gustavo. Ricardo considera casarse con Manuela para darle una última alegría a Celia, quien elige a Juan Marcos como padrino.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa llora la muerte de Carmen Rosa, la única madre que conoció, sintiéndose huérfana de afecto. Consuelo intenta acercarse al funeral pero Rosa se niega a recibirla. Isaías se mantiene firme apoyando a Rosa. Junior empeora preguntando por Rosa. Adolfo se prepara para confesarle el parentesco. Erasto continúa postrado mientras Arminda y Eustoquio planean su muerte y la apropiación de su fortuna. Vilma es interrogada por la policía sobre el intento de asesinato a Leticia. Rosalía continúa con su odio a Rosa y le exige a Alejandro pruebas formales del parentesco.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Giovanni Talamonti tiene dos hijos Augusto con su esposa y con su amante Luis Francisco y al morir les deja fortuna a cada uno en distintos lugares a Luis Francisco en Italia. Augusto no sabe de la existencia de su medio hermano. Luis Francisco conoce a Clemencia que vivía en un tráiler y hacía poco acababa de morir su padre. Se enamoran y Clemencia queda embarazada pero Luis Francisco lo desconoce y va a Italia en busca de la fortuna que heredó.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Platicamos con Adriana “Ady” Jiménez, clavadista mexicana y campeona mundial de clavados de altura, quien nos comparte cómo el deporte marcó cada etapa de su vida. Desde sus inicios en el karate hasta su ingreso al Comité Olímpico Mexicano a los 13 años, Ady Jiménez recuerda la disciplina, los sacrificios y los sueños que la formaron como atleta. Entre anécdotas de infancia, frustraciones como perder un pase olímpico en 2004 y el retiro temporal que la alejó de la plataforma durante una década, la clavadista narra su sorprendente regreso: decretar antes de saltar, vencer el miedo y abrazar la adrenalina de los 20 metros de altura. Hoy, retirada oficialmente desde 2022, Ady busca dejar un legado a través de la nueva federación de clavados, convencida de que el miedo no es un obstáculo, sino un motor. Su historia es un viaje de resiliencia, pasión y amor absoluto por el deporte.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Conversamos con Marco Navarro, ciclista de alto rendimiento y actual entrenador, quien abre su historia personal y profesional con honestidad, entrega y pasión. Desde sus primeras vueltas en bicicleta por el Bosque de Aragón en la Ciudad de México, hasta representar a México a nivel internacional, Marco comparte los desafíos de un camino marcado por la constancia, las carencias y el amor al deporte. Navarro relata cómo se forjó entre campeones, sin bicicleta propia y enfrentando lesiones, como la que lo dejó dos meses sin caminar después de una medalla. Reflexiona sobre el impacto del alto rendimiento, la rivalidad en la selección nacional, y su evolución como coach, guiando a nuevas generaciones. El episodio profundiza en lo que implica mantenerse en la cima y el valor de reinventarse, descubrimos a un hombre que transformó las caídas en impulso, y que hoy busca sembrar en otros la misma determinación que lo llevó a la élite.

programme.title: Ben y Charlie
programme.desc: Cuando, tras cumplir una condena de tres años, Ben Bellow sale de prisión, Charlie Logan lo está esperando para dejar claro que no quiere volver a saber nada de él. Sin embargo, el destino los obliga a reencontrarse una y otra vez: terminan robando un banco juntos y viviendo innumerables aventuras mientras se detestan.

programme.title: Texas El Rojo
programme.desc: La familia Sorenson es masacrada, al parecer por los indios. En el lugar de la matanza crece un pueblo, Gold Hill, dirigido por un grupo de hombres de negocios.

programme.title: La Ley de Dan Candy
programme.desc: Basada en un hecho real, esta es la trágica historia del fugitivo de Saskatchewan Almighty Voice (Gordon Tootoosis), un indio Cree que es arrestado por robar ganado del gobierno por hambre desesperada.

programme.title: Talpa
programme.desc: Cuando su exitoso hermano enferma, un hombre despreocupado debe asumir las responsabilidades del negocio familiar. Lo que comienza como una oportunidad para cambiar su vida toma un rumbo peligroso cuando surge una relación prohibida con su cuñada.

programme.title: El cuatrero errante
programme.desc: El hermano se enfrenta al hermano en esta historia de rancheros enfrentados en el viejo oeste.

programme.title: Juan Moreira
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, el arriero Juan Moreira es un buen gaucho y trabajador que, como muchos otros, es objeto de abusos y humillaciones por parte de los poderosos: los terratenientes de la policía.

programme.title: El forajido
programme.desc: Pat Garrett, Doc Holliday y Billy the Kid se enfrentan entre sí por la ley y las atenciones de la vivaz zorra campesina Río McDonald.

programme.title: Dos vivales en Fuerte Álamo
programme.desc: En plena Guerra Civil Americana, los soldados sicilianos Ciccio y Franco son encarcelados por deserción. Pero su destino da un giro inesperado cuando el ejército los recluta para una arriesgada misión de espionaje, confiando en que su torpeza aparente les permita engañar al enemigo. Una comedia bélica llena de enredos.

programme.title: El gran gato
programme.desc: Durante una sequía en Utah en los años 30, un puma amenaza al ganado y enfrenta a los granjeros. Danny se muda a la granja de su padrastro, atrapado entre tensiones familiares, un amor inesperado y el peligro creciente. Una fallida cacería al felino desata nuevas decisiones difíciles.

programme.title: Cuatro pistoleros de Santa Trinidad
programme.desc: El tráfico de armas con los indios, por un lado, y la adquisición de documentos relativos a la propiedad de una mina de oro, por otro, son los principales intereses de Quin y Gómez, los muy sospechosos huéspedes de la posada de Papá Martínez.

programme.title: Las águilas negras de Santa Fe
programme.desc: Cuando los comanches se ponen en pie de guerra, los colonos se refugian en la Roca del Águila comandada por el Capitán Jackson.

programme.title: La pantera de Monte Escondido
programme.desc: Mongo busca apoderarse del plano de un yacimiento petrolero y elimina a dos de sus compañeros. El hacendado Jacinto posee parte del mapa y encarga a Leonardo recuperar la pieza faltante. Mientras La Pantera protege a Mongo y una peligrosa búsqueda comienza en Monte Escondido, Leonardo y sus amigos se enfrentan a nuevos peligros.

programme.title: La norteña de mis amores
programme.desc: Tras el asesinato de su padre, un niño crece marcado por el deseo de venganza. Ya adulto, regresa decidido a enfrentarse al responsable, pero en el camino se enamora de una mujer que también ha sufrido por culpa del mismo enemigo. Entre el amor y la venganza, deberá elegir su destino.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Rita visita a Katya, la exesposa de Lavrov, para confirmar su coartada, y sale convencida de su inocencia: informa a su superior, Nikushin, que el verdadero objetivo del asesino podría ser Lavrov, y Katya la próxima víctima. Nikushin toma personalmente su seguridad. Mientras tanto, Rita descubre que Kosarev tuvo un hermano menor muerto en la infancia, y Lavrov empieza a sospechar de uno de sus pacientes, Starostin, quien padece trastorno de identidad disociativo.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: «Enséñame a vivir» narra el reinado de terror de un asesino en serie que rompe la paz de una ciudad tranquila. El número de víctimas no deja de crecer, y el miedo se apodera de todos. La policía cree haber atrapado al culpable y lo encierra, dando el caso por cerrado. Pero entonces ocurre un nuevo asesinato. Un psiquiatra se ofrece a ayudar en la investigación y accede a reunirse con el sospechoso... quien le revela una verdad aterradora y mucho más peligrosa de lo que nadie imaginaba.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: La investigación destapa una serie de asesinatos con el mismo patrón, ocurridos hace 25 años. Su autor, Kosarev, cumple cadena perpetua y acaba de ver rechazada su libertad condicional por la comisión de Lavrov. Entre tensiones con Lavrov, Storozheva lo acompaña a visitar al exdetective Puchkov, quien trabajó el caso original... pero se niega a colaborar y actúa con sospecha. Al vigilarlo, descubren su vínculo con Gavrishin, el principal sospechoso de aquellos crímenes.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Puchkov se reúne con Kosarev en prisión. Este último cree que los nuevos asesinatos pueden probar su inocencia. Gavrishin, sintiéndose nuevamente sospechoso, atrae a Lavrov a una imprenta abandonada para contarle su versión de los hechos. Rita y el oficial Tolik llegan al lugar, pero durante la detención, Gavrishin sufre un shock insulínico. Esa misma noche, asesinan a otra mujer, quien resulta ser paciente de Lavrov en la clínica psiquiátrica.

Nikushin toma personalmente su seguridad. Mientras tanto, Rita descubre que Kosarev tuvo un hermano menor muerto en la infancia, y Lavrov empieza a sospechar de uno de sus pacientes, Starostin, quien padece trastorno de identidad disociativo.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Lavrov descubre que estaba equivocado sobre Starostin. Nikushin esconde a Katya en un apartamento secreto y entre ellos surge una atracción. Lavrov empieza a sentirse vigilado, instala una cámara oculta en su oficina y, al revisar las grabaciones, reconoce a alguien entrando. Esa noche, aparece inesperadamente en la casa de Rita, causando un gran susto a su madre.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Nikushin consigue permiso para que Rita y Lavrov visiten a Kosarev en prisión. Durante una fiesta en honor al dueño de la clínica psiquiátrica, Lavrov confronta al desconocido que irrumpió en su oficina. Más tarde, él y Rita dejan la ciudad para entrevistarse con Kosarev. Mientras tanto, un desconocido irrumpe en el apartamento donde se esconde Katya.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: A través del análisis psicológico, Lavrov descubre que Kosarev conoce al verdadero asesino, pero se niega a revelar su identidad. Nikushin encuentra a Katya en un hotel. Un compañero de celda de Kosarev le entrega a Rita y Lavrov una carta que Kosarev intentó destruir. Aunque el remitente usa una dirección falsa, la información hace que Lavrov sospeche de Nikushin.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Lavrov intenta advertir a Katya del peligro, pero ella no le cree. Rita, por su parte, duda de la culpabilidad de Nikushin. Mientras Lavrov investiga el pasado de Nikushin, Rita sigue una pista sobre la posible implicación de medicamentos en los asesinatos en serie. Katya le confiesa a Nikushin que en el pasado ya intentaron asesinarla. Esa misma noche, otra mujer es asesinada.

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: This week we dive into whitetail anatomy to explain the science behind a humane harvest. Learn how the mediastinum and thoracic pressure dictate lung collapse after a shot, see how these biological insights pay off during a challenging rut hunt, and get tips on spring food plot preparation.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: In this episode, we break down how weather impacts your setup and strategy, and how to use it to your advantage. Then we head to Oklahoma for an exciting whitetail hunt, where patience and preparation come together for a shot at a mature buck.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: A "Best of..." episode spanning the past 4 seasons of Winchester Life.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: The Cast

programme.title: The Cast

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we’re kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The next stop on our Florida Keys adventure brings Rush Maltz to the legendary waters of Islamorada — a destination known for its laid-back island vibe, world-class fishing, fine dining, and easy access to the reef. Joining locals Jimmy Hendrix and Jordi Hortensi, the game plan is simple: check in by boat, chase fish, eat well, and go dive. From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.desc: Hunting has a way of grounding us, reminding us of what truly matters: shared moments and unforgettable memories. Chance and Ashleigh Eckert are on their first out-of-state hunt in the rolling hills of Ohio. After overcoming a life-changing kidney transplant, their story is one of faith, love, and resilience. While the goal was a big buck, the true reward was the time spent together and the lessons learned along the way. Because hunting is about so much more than the harvest — it’s about the journey.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: The Aware Show

He’s been with his life partner, soulmate, and wife, Deborah, for 47 years, and in practice as a psychologist for more than 45 years. His most recent book, Riding the Edge, A Love Song to Deborah, chronicles his six-month transformative journey.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.sub-title: Help for the Hurting Heart Day 1
programme.desc: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.sub-title: Help for the Hurting Heart Day 2

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.sub-title: Help for the Hurting Heart Day 3

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler

programme.title: An Evening of Bell House Debuts
programme.desc: Hosted by Chris Gethard, this Brooklyn showcase features emerging stand-ups connecting with a community of rising talent in a live comedy debut series.

programme.title: Dropkick Murphys: St. Patrick’s Day 2024 Live from Boston
programme.desc: Dropkick Murphys return home to Boston for their annual St. Patrick’s Day concert at the MGM Music Hall at Fenway, performing fan favorites like “The Boys Are Back,” “The State of Massachusetts,” “Queen of Suffolk County,” and “Johnny, I Hardly Knew Ya.” With surprise guest Billy Bragg opening the show, plus appearances by Kneecap and Pennywise, the night captures the fierce pride, Celtic punk energy, and hometown spirit that define the band’s legacy.

programme.title: In Conversation Lucy Dacus and Katie Gavin
programme.desc: Dacus and Gavin chat in LA, discussing Dacus's new record and their friendship, filled with giggles.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Multitalented comedian, musician, and author Reggie Watts joins Joel Madden to discuss his creative evolution—from growing up in Montana to shaping the alt-comedy and music scenes in Seattle, New York, and Los Angeles. Watts reflects on his improvisational approach, performing in countless bands, and his Veeps comedy special Never Mind, revealing how curiosity and playfulness drive his art.

programme.title: Kings of Leon: Live at The O2 London, England
programme.desc: Kings of Leon performs live at The O2 in London, delivering hits like Sex on Fire and Use Somebody in a high-energy set.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Carly Pearce on Artist Friendly. Pearce reflects on leaving high school at 16 for Dollywood, moving to Nashville at 19, and years of grinding before her breakthrough. She opens up about trusting her instincts, turning heartbreak into Grammy-winning music, and making peace with the hardest chapters of her story.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy Award–winning country singer-songwriter Lainey Wilson joins Joel Madden to talk about growing up in rural Louisiana, chasing her Nashville dreams, and building a career through perseverance and purpose. They discuss her new album Whirlwind, the balance between ambition and well-being, and the lessons that come from hardship, therapy, and self-discovery.

programme.title: First Listen: Motel Du Cap – Live with Good Charlotte
programme.desc: Hear Good Charlotte's new album in full with exclusive stories, commentary, and fan Q&A. Your front-row seat to Motel Du Cap.

programme.title: Oasis: Standing on the Edge of the Noise
programme.desc: Oasis performs an intimate rehearsal set at Black Island Studios, featuring tracks from Dig Out Your Soul alongside classics and rarities.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Poppy calls off “spin the bottle” when the puppets’ gross habits come to light, launching a chaotic crash course in hygiene and self-care. A parody round of Is It Cake? serves up a shocking twist, Detective Poppy makes a noir-style debut to hunt down a nasty rumor about Mr. Skip, and Zwink gets a spa day that tackles stink and sadness—ending with a catchy cleanliness anthem. TV-14. Fictional violence and language.

programme.title: Jimmy Eat World: 20th Anniversary of “Futures” Live From Phoenix
programme.desc: Jimmy Eat World return to their hometown for a one-night celebration of the 20th anniversary of Futures, performing the album front to back at The Van Buren in Phoenix, Arizona. Featuring fan-favorite tracks (“Futures,” “Just Tonight…,” “Work,” “The World You Love,” “Pain,” “Drugs or Me”) and special hometown moments from the band.

programme.title: Forte
programme.desc: Forte challenges outdated notions of success in classical music through the fast-paced narrative of three female artists.

programme.title: Billy Idol: State Line Live at the Hoover Dam
programme.desc: Punk icon Billy Idol makes history with the first-ever concert at the Hoover Dam, performing alongside longtime collaborator Steve Stevens and his band. This landmark event blends raw rock energy with stunning desert visuals and intimate acoustic moments. Featuring special guests Alison Mosshart (The Kills), Steve Jones (Sex Pistols), and Tony Kanal (No Doubt.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Multi-platinum artist Darius Rucker joins Joel Madden to reflect on his journey from fronting Hootie & the Blowfish to becoming a country music icon. Rucker opens up about balancing family and touring, the band’s legacy, and the honesty that drives his songwriting. He also discusses breaking barriers in country music and his new memoir, Life’s Too Short, offering heartfelt insight into perseverance and authenticity.

programme.title: Backstreet Boys: Homecoming - Live In Orlando
programme.desc: Backstreet Boys returns to Orlando for a 1999 homecoming concert, performing hits like As Long As You Love Me and Everybody (Backstreet’s Back).

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Mae Martin: "I'm a TV"
programme.desc: Mae Martin’s I’m a TV, captured live in Los Angeles. Blending intimate indie-pop songs with witty onstage banter, Mae performs new material on the eve of the album’s release and sharing stories that inspired tracks like “Say the Word,” “Try Me,” “Don’t Get Tired of Me,” and “Garbage Strike.” A confessional, funny, and heartfelt set about love, reinvention, and finding calm in the chaos.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Mikaela Hoover discusses art and life on Artist Friendly, sharing personal insights and her pride in her wife's company, House of Harlow.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Professor Poppy turns “school” upside down: a fractions lesson with a jewel-cam and a reality-bending sync glitch spirals into a nightmare of beans; a hands-on grip tutorial earns Poppy her union card; and dueling magicians escalate their rivalry from stage tricks to existential dread—before Poppy closes with a catchy lesson-on-learning performance. TV-14 (fictional violence, language).

programme.title: Benji & Joel Madden / Cameron Diaz & Katherine Power: Side Hustles
programme.desc: Good Charlotte’s Benji and Joel Madden share their journey into artist management, while Cameron Diaz and Katherine Power discuss building their organic wine brand, Avaline.

programme.title: Jay Pharoah: Can I Be Me?
programme.desc: Jay Pharoah delivers a stand-up special packed with celebrity impressions and sharp humor, featuring takes on icons like Jay-Z, Barack Obama, and more.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Jon Foreman, frontman of the GRAMMY-winning rock band Switchfoot, joins Joel Madden for a thoughtful conversation on surfing, faith, creativity, and the balance between joy and discomfort. They explore themes of mindfulness, artistic purpose, and growth through challenge — diving into Jon’s new solo album In Bloom and the philosophies that guide both his music and his life.

programme.title: String Theory: Guitar Obsessed
programme.desc: String Theory: Guitar Obsessed delivers a humorous but reverent look at why we love the guitar. Among the 24 distinguished people in the film: Execs from 5 major manufactures, 4 well known internet instructors and retail guitar store owners in the USA and the UK...plus distinguished professors and even the former Deputy Director of the FBI. If you play guitar, you will want to see this movie.

programme.title: Get Thrashed Around The World
programme.desc: Stellar metal bands came out of Germany, UK, France, Brazil, Canada, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Canada, and more as part of the Thrash Metal movement. Members of bands like Slayer, Metallica, Slipknot, and Exodus reminisce about their favorite bands and the best musicians of the era. A virtual encyclopedia of metal bands that toured the world, but that fans may have forgotten or can now discover.

programme.title: Shostakovich

programme.title: Faure's Requiem
programme.desc: Winchester Cathedral Orchestra and the English Chamber Choir perform the piece; host John Gielgud.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert

programme.title: The Babylon Hotel

programme.title: Beethoven: Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55

programme.sub-title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El homenaje de Mikey al Día D, un salto en paracaídas con 20 paracaidistas, encuentra un obstáculo cuando Joe se niega a pilotar su DC-3 hasta la zona de salto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El copiloto novato Scott se enfrenta a su peor pesadilla cuando un motor Curtiss C-46 Commando y una baja niebla obligan a un aterrizaje aterrador. El joven y ambicioso volador Alex debe demostrar su valía cuando el piloto principal de Buffalo le da el control del Douglas DC-4 de 20 toneladas por primera vez.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La Navidad está a la vuelta de la esquina, pero la comida y el correo cruciales de Buffalo se detienen. Una incautación del motor deja a Scott, AJ y el avión C-46, creando una reacción en cadena caótica. El crujiente mecánico Chuck debe intentar un cambio de motor con las manos desnudas en menos 30, y la presión de los clientes y compañeros de trabajo empuja al gerente de carga Kelly.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Una racha de mala suerte hace que el 66 grados cumpleaños del piloto en jefe Arnie huya del infierno y amenaza con estropear su sorpresa de cumpleaños traviesa. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy está desesperado por ascender en los rangos, pero una novata podría arrojar una llave en sus planes, después de que la tripulación trabaja toda la noche para convertir el DC-4 en un tanque de gas volador.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando una falla de energía deja a Rankin Inlet expuesto a los elementos brutales del norte, el capitán Justin corre para entregar un generador de emergencia. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy intenta adelantarse a la compañera de trabajo Audrey entrenando a un nuevo empleado de la India para reemplazarlo. Y cuando la recesión pisa los talones de Joe, intenta negociar un acuerdo de $ 7 millones.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El mecánico Cory corre contra el reloj para convertir dos bombas de agua de corto alcance en aviones transatlánticos para el viaje épico a Turquía. Depende del ingeniero Adam sacar a la tripulación del C-46 de un atasco en una pista de aterrizaje remota en menos 40. Y cuando el capitán Devan y el copiloto Scott encuentran la amenaza de la cizalladura del viento en el famoso Bear Rock.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un vuelo charter cae por las grietas después de que los McBryans asisten a una boda familiar salvaje, y un furioso Joe saca al capitán Justin de los vuelos de prueba de Turquía para hacer el trabajo. La tarea de Justin es trasladar a un británico impaciente, su perro y todas sus posesiones mundanas a un remoto puesto avanzado del norte, pero el clima no está cooperando.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un furioso Joe lucha contra una suspensión federal que le impedirá transportar pasajeros por primera vez en 20 años. También es un revés para Jeremy y las otras rampas, que empeora con una lesión inesperada. Para el equipo de waterbomber de Turquía, finalmente es una oportunidad.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: AJ y Candace se casan en el Castillo de Hielo. Un frustrado Chuck intenta que la Electra le pague. Mikey, desconcertado, intenta hornear un pastel para el cumpleaños de Joe. Y en Terranova, una fuga de combustible, un curso de supervivencia aleccionador y un trágico choque sacudieron a la tripulación de Turquía. Cuando los fuertes vientos brinden la ventana meteorológica tan esperada.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La tripulación de Turquía hace el salto crítico sobre el Atlántico Norte. Pero en el camino a Portugal, un equipo se ve obligado a regresar. Sin potencia en un motor y sin forma de mantener la altitud, deben regresar a Santa María, donde el aeropuerto está en alerta de emergencia completa. Y Mikey y Scott buscan una nueva rampie, mientras que las esperanzas de Jeremy se desploman aún más.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Las tripulaciones C-46 y DC-4 compiten contra el deshielo primaveral para volar equipos mineros a una pista de aterrizaje en un lago congelado. Jeremy intenta alcanzar a sus compañeros rampies Audrey y Wilf. Y en el último tramo a Turquía, Arnie y Justin se enfrentan a algunos volcanes serios y al intenso tráfico aéreo del Mediterráneo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de miles de horas de preparación minuciosa y vuelo peligroso, un terrible accidente devasta a la tripulación de los bombarderos de agua en Turquía, y a todos en Buffalo. La primera carrera de Wilf como azafata levanta las cejas entre el personal. Y un aficionado a los aviones escoceses cumple el sueño de su vida cuando Joe lo deja viajar en el asiento del capitán de su DC-3.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando su esposo renuncia después de un reventón con Joe, Kelly se pone en una posición terrible. ¿Se quedará en Buffalo o se irá? Scott recibe la noticia de que debe retirarse del vuelo para que otro copiloto pueda acelerar el paso al capitán. Él hace todo lo posible para asegurar una nueva carta, pero su rival también quiere volar el nuevo trabajo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de la amarga partida de su esposo de Buffalo, Kelly tiene una confrontación que decide si ella también renunciará. Jeremy comete un error que podría terminar con su carrera en Buffalo. La escasez de gasolina de aviación trae una dosis de realidad aleccionadora a los McBryans. Y después de una visita de su madre, el destino le lanza a Scott una inesperada bola curva.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe pelea una demanda de Transport Canada contra la aerolínea.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando un incendio mortal destruye un puesto de avanzada en el norte una semana antes de Navidad.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La maldición del -40 golpea a los pilotos de Buffalo, Devan y Scott, en un vuelo por correo de alimentos.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Mikey va en busca del tesoro a Venezuela en busca de un raro waterbomber CL-215.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un enlace de ferry vital está caído, por lo que Buffalo organiza una campaña total para transportar 100,000 libras de productos.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.sub-title: No Te Metas Con Chuck Adam
programme.desc: El mecánico crujiente Chuck lidera la lucha para preparar a los Electra para una misión de socorro en casos de desastre en Haití.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Una misión de varias paradas al Extremo Norte tiene a Devan, Scott y Adam enfrentando una serie de obstáculos de nudillos blancos.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Los jóvenes pilotos AJ y Andrew tienen la oportunidad de su vida de volar el magnífico DC-3.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Buffalo obtiene la carta de su vida cuando se les pide que transporten la Copa Stanley en una gira por el Norte.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El piloto principal Arnie aterriza el DC-3 en una franja de arena casera en un refugio remoto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando las tormentas eléctricas y un motor tembloroso amenazan un alquiler de DC-3 a Whitehorse.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe y Mikey se dirigen a Coventry, Inglaterra, para explorar la posible compra de un turbohélice Electra.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Mientras entrena a los capitanes de bombas de agua para la próxima temporada de extinción de incendios.

programme.desc: Robin sigue una corazonada sobre un nuevo sitio en un antiguo reclamo.

programme.desc: Guy lucha con la excavadora para exponer un hallazgo enorme.

programme.desc: Los aguaceros amenazan la seguridad de la tripulación y cierran la minería en el Pozo 3.

programme.desc: Cuando un importante comprador de jade no queda impresionado con la lente Pozo 3, Claudia se ve obligada a tomar una decisión difícil.

programme.desc: La carrera para preparar el campamento en Wolverine se convierte en una pesadilla.

programme.desc: El brutal viaje a una nueva mina separa a la familia y lleva a Josh al límite.

programme.desc: Los pequeños lujos en el campamento animan a un equipo descontento y los visitantes sorpresa aumentan las esperanzas de Claudia.
